cohort: Human ovarian biopsies were obtained from 14 women at the time of caesarean section, and 38 mouse ovaries were obtained from neonatal C57Bl/6J mice.
finding: Exposure to cisplatin or doxorubicin individually significantly decreased follicle health and number, increased apoptosis, and decreased cell proliferation in human and mouse ovarian tissue, but no multiplicative effects were observed when the drugs were combined.
